Clavis Steganographiae (Clavis triplex) — letter-pair cipher chunk full_chunk_0113

Steganographia clavis convention: each plaintext letter maps to a single ciphertext letter. The substitution is designed so the cipher letters can be padded into a Latin prose Exemplum that reads as ordinary devotional writing -- only the recipient who knows the alphabet can decode the embedded German Intentio.
